title: Idempotent order recorder creates exactly one entry per key
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag returning the original payload when a duplicate arrives with a different payload as data loss. That is the idempotency contract: the first recording wins, duplicates are acknowledgements of it, and the atomic lock makes the guarantee hold under concurrency.
